summary: Kazia Therapeutics Limited filed a prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 amending its prior F-3 shelf registration and ATM facility with Leerink Partners. The filing reduces the maximum aggregate offering price under the Sales Agreement from $100 million to $80 million, reflecting that ADSs (each representing 500 ordinary shares) are sold from time to time. As of the filing, 510,000 ADSs had been sold for approximately $5.1 million. The ADSs trade on Nasdaq under KZIA; the August 27, 2026 closing price was $16.90 per ADS. This is a routine takedown amendment to an ATM facility, not a special situation. No transaction terms, premiums, or structural changes are present. What to watch: ongoing ATM sales and any resulting dilution.
